name: Nader Abdelshahid
headline: Software Engineer | Java and Spring Boot | Distributed Payments and Backend Systems
summary: Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience, including 4+ years building Java/Spring Boot backend services for FedNow and TCH RTP real-time payments. Delivers REST APIs, ISO 20022 processing, Kafka event mappings, MongoDB persistence, CI/CD, and security remediation in a regulated financial environment. Built reusable automation that reduced recurring API and database validation time by 67%, from ~30 minutes to ~10 minutes.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built reusable Postman/Newman and MongoDB automation that cut recurring API/database validation time by 67%, from ~30 minutes to ~10 minutes, and standardized review evidence.

Develop and maintain Java/Spring Boot backend services and REST APIs for distributed FedNow and TCH RTP v3.0 payments, resolving defects across credit transfers, returns, request-for-payment (RFP), and administrative-message workflows.
Delivered ISO 20022 updates for pacs.008, pacs.002, pacs.004, camt.029, camt.035, pain.014, and admi.002, integrating Kafka event mappings, MongoDB persistence, and network-specific processing rules.
Expanded JUnit coverage across payment mappers, controllers, exception handlers, Kafka publishers, and FedNow/TCH processors to strengthen regression testing for payment-service changes.
Remediated security and software composition analysis findings using Black Duck and Checkmarx scan results across credit-transfer, administrative-message, and return-of-funds services.

Validated Jenkins/SonarQube CI/CD quality gates and service changes in DEV, SIT, and UAT; collaborated with engineering, risk, compliance, network, and platform teams on issue resolution and controlled releases.

experience.title: Freelance Software Developer
bullets: Develop full-stack web projects using JavaScript, React, Ruby on Rails, REST APIs, and database-backed applications.

experience.title: Software Engineer / Consultant
bullets: Developed and refactored web and mobile applications using React, React Native, AngularJS, Ionic, and Ruby on Rails; contributed to testing, debugging, documentation, and collaborative development workflows.

project.title: API and Database Automation Workbench — Independent Personal Project
bullets: Built a modular developer workbench with a Spring Boot backend and React/Vite interface to orchestrate runtime checks, Postman/Newman API execution, MongoDB validation, and JUnit runs.
Integrated CI/CD quality checks, redacted runtime logs, and evidence packaging into reusable workflows to make execution repeatable and engineering review traceable.
